RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Question s for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, the July 15, 2002/Asadha 24, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Development of North Eastern Region; Disinvestment; Health and
Family Welfare; Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises; Information
 and Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Shipping;
Social Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Urban
Development and Poverty Alleviation)
Total number of questions—20
1
FDI in print media
*1. SHRI ABANI ROY:
DR. ABRAR AHMED:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to allow 26 per cent foreign direct investment
in print media inspite of stiff opposition;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether the small and medium
newspaper industry in the country is likely
to suffer a lot due to this decision; and
(d) if so, the steps Government are going
to take to protect them?
Disinvestment of PSUs
*2. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of public
undertakings under various Ministries,
Ministry-wise;
(b) the total number of PSUs in respect
of which decision has been taken to
disinvest them and proceeds realized after
completing the process of disinvestment/
sale;
(c) the number of PSUs in respect of
which a decision has been taken to disinvest
but the process not yet completed/proceeds
not yet realized after the sale/disinvestment;
and
(d) the number of PSUs still with
Government and the steps taken to improve
their management and functioning?
Disposal of surplus land of VSNL
*3. SHRI PRITHVIRAJ CHAVAN:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
floating a separate company to dispose of
surplus land available with the VSNL;
(b) whether any agreement has been
reached with the new management of
VSNL;
(c) whether permission to float a new
company will have to be taken from US
Securities and Exchange Commission; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

2
F:\WIN2\1893RS.pm5
National Judicial Commission
*4. SHRI C.P. THIRUNAVUKKA-
RASU: Will the Minister of LAW AND
JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to form a National Judicial Commission for
making appointments in Judiciary; and
(b) if so, by when it will be formed?
Bifurcation of National Commission
for SCs and STs
*5. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA:
SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government propose to
bifurcate the National Commission for
Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes;
and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor?
Increase in seats in Dental and Medical
Colleges
*6. SHRI JIBON ROY: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item captioned,
"Admissions: 76 Dental, Medical Colleges
out", which appeared in the Indian Express
dated the 17th June, 2002; and
(b) if so, what steps Government have
taken to increase seats in Dental and
Medical Colleges so that students do not
suffer because of malafide intentions of
some Private/Government Medical
Colleges?
Absentee doctors in AIIMS
†*7. SHRI RAMA SHANKER
KAUSHIK: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) since when senior doctors of various
important departments of AIIMS have been
absent;
(b) the number of such absentees along
with the names of their respective
departments and whether it is a fact that all
facilities including job, accommodation,
telephone to such absentee doctors have not
only been continuing but they have been
given promotions also;
(c) the reasons for not taking any action
against the said doctors; and
(d) the payments made by Government,
so far, to the said doctors and the action
Government would take to terminate their
services and to recover the said payments
from them?
Research work at AIIMS
*8. SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item captioned,
"Research work at AIIMS being hampered
for want of animals", which appeared in the
Hindustan Times, dated the 11th June, 2002;
(b) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto; and
(c) the steps proposed to be taken to
address the problems highlighted by the
news-item which are hampering the medical
research at AIIMS?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

3
F:\WIN2\1893RS.pm5
Collection of property tax from
Central Government assets
*9. SHRI PRASANTA CHATTER-
JEE: Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT AND POVERTY
ALLEVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have agreed, in principle, to allow the local
bodies to collect property tax in respect of
Central Government assets; and
(b) if so, the latest position in this regard?
Investment of VSNL capital in Tata
Teleservices
*10. SHRI NILOTPAL BASU: Will the
Minister of DISINVESTMENT be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Tata Group
has purchased controlling share of VSNL
in the process of disinvestment;
(b) if so, the amount paid by Tata to
Government and the details of the valuation
of VSNL;
(c) whether it is also a fact that VSNL
Board decided to invest Rs. 1200 crores in
Tata Teleservices, a Tata Group Company;
and
(d) whether such an investment
decision is in keeping with a major stated
objective of disinvestment to substitute
public investment with private investment?
Reports of Disinvestment Commission
*11.  SHRI KAILASH JOSHI : Will
the Minister of DISINVESTMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the reports given by the
Disinvestment Commission so far;
(b) the main recommendations of the
Commission; and
(c) the details of the recommendations
accepted by Government keeping in view
the interest of workers and employees of
the public sector undertakings?
New male contraceptive
*12. SHRI YADLAPATI VENKAT
RAO:
SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
 Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have introduced
a new male contraceptive in order to boost
family planning;
(b) if so, whether efficacy of this
contraceptive and its acceptability on wider
scale has been confirmed; and
(c) the other details in this regard?
Sale of drugs through internet
*13. SHRI LAJPAT RAI: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a new method
to sell drugs through internet has come to
light;
(b) if so, the number of cases detected,
so far, case-wise;
(c) how many drug dealers are involved
and the action initiated against them;
(d) whether it is also a fact that all this
has been going on in connivance with
customs officers; and
(e) if so, whether any arrests have been
made and the details of revelations through
investigations?

4
F:\WIN2\1893RS.pm5
SC direction on candidates contesting
elections
*14. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY:
SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE:
Will the Minister of LAW AND
JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Supreme Court of India
in a recent judgement has ruled that a
candidate willing to stand for elections must
declare his/her assets and criminal
antecedents, if any;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
give effect to this directive of the Supreme
Court?
Guidelines relating to film certification
*15. SHRI BHAGATRAM
MANHAR:
SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
 Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item captioned,
"Censor Anand to clear more screen nudity
with 'X' rating", which appeared in the Asian
Age, New Delhi, dated the 21st June, 2002;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto;
(c) whether Government propose to
amend the existing guidelines and propose
to clear films with extra doses of nudity and
vulgarity with a special 'X' certificate; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Action against Doordarshan
defaulters
*16. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
 Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Doordarshan has
initiated action against private producers and
agencies which owe a total of Rs.169.28
crores;
(b) if so, the total number of private
producers and agencies which have been
continuously delaying payments;
(c) how much has so far, been recovered
from them;
(d) in how many cases legal action has
been taken; and
(e) how many, out of the defaulters, have
been refused permission or extension of
their programme?
Joint venture between India and Iran
*17. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of URBAN DEVELOP-
MENT AND POVERTY ALLEVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether India and Iran have decided
to take-up joint infrastructure projects in
Afghanistan and other countries of the
region;
(b) whether India has offered help to
Iran in improving the infrastructure in large
cities in Iran, such as Teheran; and
(c) if so, the details in this regard?

5
F:\WIN2\1893RS.pm5
Surprise checks of CGHS dispensaries
*18.  SHRI K. KALAVENKATA RAO:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are carrying out
surprise checks of CGHS dispensaries to
ensure availability of medicines as well as
punctuality of doctors and staff;
(b) if so, the number of raids conducted
during the last six months Dispensary-wise
in Delhi; and
(c) the results of the raids as well as
action taken against the errant doctors or
other staff?
Filling of vacancies of Judges
*19.  SHRI K. NATWAR SINGH: Will
the Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has blamed the
States for inordinate delay in filling up
vacancies of Judges in fast track courts
resulting in accumulation of arrears of 2.4
crore cases in the subordinate courts;
(b) whether any directive has been
issued to the States to fill-up these vacancies
under a time-bound programme;
(c) if so, whether any specific date has
been given to States by which time these
vacancies are to be filled up; and
(d) if so, which are the States which
have not implemented the directive of
Government in filling up the vacancies of
Judges?
Non-Implementation of ACP scheme in
CGHS
*20.  SHRI NANA DESHMUKH: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-items captioned,
"Health Check: CGHS arteries blocked" and
"CGHS staffers demand promotions",
which appeared in the Hindustan Times and
Indian Express on 17th and 19th June, 2002,
respectively;
(b) the details of steps being taken to
augment the surprise visits of the
dispensaries;
(c) whether one of the main reasons for
ill-functioning of the CGHS dispensaries is
denying promotion to CGHS Staffers;
(d) if so, the reasons for non-
implementation of the Assured Career
Progression (ACP) scheme to CGHS
pharmacists; and
(e) the steps being taken to implement
the scheme for them?
NEW DELHI; R.C. TRIPATHI,
The 9th July, 2002 Secretary-General.

————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, the July 15, 2002/Asadha 24, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Development of North-Eastern Region; Disinvestment; Health
and Family Welfare; Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises; Information
and Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Shipping; Social Justice and
Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Urban  Development and
Poverty Alleviation)
Total number of questions—51
1
News-item "Disinvestment train on
slow track"
1. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR REDDY:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item captioned,
"Disinvestment train on slow track", which
appeared in the Business Standard dated
13th June, 2002;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
and
(c) the steps proposed to be taken to
address the problems responsible for the
slow-down of the disinvestment process as
highlighted in the news-item?
Disinvestment of PSUs
2. SHRI BHAGATRAM MANHAR:
SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to disinvest National Fertilizers Limited
(NFL);
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have decided
to disinvest PSUs like EIL, BEML, RCF,
NALCO, Neyveli Lignite Corporation and
STC Limited; and
(d) if so, the latest position with regard
to disinvestment of these PSUs, Company-
wise?
Demonstration by CGHS employees
3. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Central Government
Health Scheme employees held a
demonstration on the 19th, June 2002 in
support of their demands in New Delhi;
(b) whether the recommendations of the
Fifth Pay Commission concerning these
employees have not been implemented;
and
(c) Government's response to their
demands?

2
WIN2\SESSION\RS1895.PM5 2
CAG report on National Programme
for Control of Blindness
4. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Comptroller and Auditor
General of India has criticized Government
for poor implementation of National
Programme for Control of Blindness;
(b) if so, whether according to the report
placed before the Parliament, it has pointed
out that more than 70 lakh prospective
beneficiaries were left untargeted;
(c) if so, the main reasons for not
implementing the National Programme for
Blindness; and
(d) the measures Government propose
to take to implement fully the project for
removing blindness in the country?
National Health Policy
5. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
announced the new National Health Policy;
(b) if so, whether Government propose
that two years' of rural posting would be
mandatory for medical graduates and would
be done through the Medical Council;
(c) if so, the other main features of the
policy; and
(d) the steps being taken to implement
them?
Winding up of CGHS dispensaries
6. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
wind up CGHS dispensaries in congested
localities as several local doctors are available
for consultation and restrict dispensaries
to far-flung areas only where doctors are
not available, especially in rural areas;
(b) if so, the details of plans made in this
regard; and
(c) if not, how health care of people will
be taken care of in far-flung rural
areas?
Supply of oxygen in Kalavati Saran
Children's Hospital
†7. SHRI RAMA SHANKER
KAUSHIK: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether an attempt to kill dozens of
new born babies/child patients was made
by stopping supply of oxygen on the 1st
June, 2002 in Kalavati Saran Children's
Hospital;
(b) whether Government have taken any
action against the culprits after making
inquiries into the incident of shutting off the
oxygen plant;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether Government have ensured
that the parents of the hospitalized children
remain free from fear and such incident does
not recur in future; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

3
WIN2\SESSION\RS1895.PM5 3
Options to CGHS beneficiaries
8. DR. ALLADI  P. RAJKUMAR: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
consider giving options to CGHS
beneficiaries to consult reputed doctors
locally and purchase medicines direct instead
of visiting CGHS dispensaries where
medicines prescribed are not available and
doctors generally are not in their seats;
(b) if so, the plans made in this regard;
and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Working of CGHS dispensaries
9.  SHRI YADLAPATI VENKAT
RAO: Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether working of CGHS
dispensaries are not to the satisfaction  of
the patients;
(b) if so, the details of analysis made in
this regard; and
(c) any alternative proposals for CGHS
beneficiaries to avail of assistance of local
doctors and chemists?
Services of Gynaecologists in rural
PHCs
10. DR. DASARI NARAYANA RAO:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
most of the PHCs in rural areas are manned
by male doctors which deters the rural
women to disclose their serious diseases in
public before the physician;
(b) if so, whether Government propose
to provide the services of female
Gynaecologists in the rural primary health
centres or ensure that PHCs are visited by
experienced Gynaecologists at least twice a
month to attend the health problems of rural
women and girls; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Medical stores dealing in fake drugs
11. SHRI LAJPAT RAI: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that certain medical
stores/shops in certain parts of the country
have been found dealing in fake and sub-
standard drugs;
(b) if so, the details of the cases;
and
(c) whether it is also a fact that a drug
dealer of Delhi has revealed during
interrogation that he had been supplying fake
and sub-standard drugs to many dealers in
the country?
Campaign for hygiene, cleanliness in
hospitals
12. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are considering
any proposal to initiate a campaign for
ensuring hygiene, cleanliness and the one
aimed at improving efficiency, cutting short
of procedures with a view to helping
patients, duly backed by Confederation of
Indian Industry, as started by
Government of Delhi in respect of their
hospitals;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?

4
WIN2\SESSION\RS1895.PM5 4
Condition of Dental Unit of Dr. RML
Hospital
13. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA:
DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that working of
the Dental Unit of Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia
Hospital in New Delhi is deplorable;
(b) whether imported equipment of the
unit is lying unused for want of proper
maintenance;
(c) whether the task of maintenance of
this unit has been entrusted to private parties
and their service is not satisfactory;
(d) whether poor patients have to suffer
on account of malfunctioning of the unit;
and
(e) the steps proposed to improve this
situation?
Report of Task Force on CGHS
dispensaries in Delhi
14. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR REDDY:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that following
numerous complaints with regard to the
functioning of CGHS dispensaries in the
Capital a five member Task Force was
appointed by his Ministry to enquire into
the matter;
(b) if so, whether the Task Force has
since submitted its report;
(c) if answer to part (b) be in the negative,
by when the report is expected by
Government; and
(d) the steps proposed to be taken in the
meanwhile to improve the quality of
C.G.H.S. services?
News-item "Health check : CGHS
arteries blocked"
15. SHRI RUMANDLA
RAMACHANDRAIAH:
SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item captioned,
"Health check: CGHS arteries blocked",
which appeared in the Hindustan Times,
dated the 17th June, 2002;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
and
(c) the measures Government propose
to take to improve the quality of service in
the CGHS which seems to be on the brink
of a collapse?
Mentally-challenged persons in the
country
16. SHRI C.O. POULOSE: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE  be pleased to state:
(a) the States which have their own
mental hospitals;
(b) the total number of mentally-
challenged persons in the country, State-
wise;
(c) the growth rate of mentally-
challenged persons during the last five years;
and
(d) the reaction of Government thereto?
Proposal to set-up gas-based power
plant in AIIMS
17. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a proposal to set-up

5
WIN2\SESSION\RS1895.PM5 5
a gas-based power plant in order to
maintain constant power supply for
AIIMS;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the proposed power plant
would also supply power to Safdarjung
Hospital; and
(d) by when the power plant is likely to
be operational?
News-item, "Doctors in a fix over pre-
natal test rules"
18. SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item, "Doctors in a
fix over pre-natal test rules," which appeared
in the Hindustan Times, dated 4th June,
2002;
(b) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto; and
(c) the steps proposed to be taken to
address the problem raised in the
news-item?
Prevalence of Diarrhoea
19. SHRI PRASANTA CHATTER-
JEE: Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) how many people have suffered due
to Diarrhoea in the country during the years
1999, 2000 and 2001 and the number of
deaths in each year; and
(b) the current figure in Metropolitan
cities during January-April, 2002?
Discrimination in reimbursement of
medical expenses
20. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR REDDY:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
reimbursement of medical expenses incurred
in private, hospitals recognized by the
CGHS authorities in terms of his Ministry's
OM dated the 7th September, 2001 is limited
to the 50 per cent of the actual expenses
incurred by a pensioner as against the 100
per cent reimbursement made to a serving
officer;
(b) if so, the reasons for this
discrimination; and
(c) whether there is a move to remove
the discrimination and if not, the reasons
therefor?
Tackling Thalassemia
21. SHRI PRASANTA CHATTER-
JEE: Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) how the dreaded diseases like
Thalassemia are being tackled by
Government;
(b) whether his Ministry has any plan to
advocate compulsory blood testing to detect
the carriers before marriage; and
(c) whether Government have initiated
any awareness programme in this regard?
Losses in Medical Stores Depot
22. SHRI LAJPAT RAI: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
Medical Stores Depot has been running in
loss;

6
WIN2\SESSION\RS1895.PM5 6
(b) if so, the details thereof during the
last five years;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
establishment cost has increased almost
double during the five years period from
1994-95 to 1999-2000;
(d) if so, the justification thereof; and
(e) whether it is also a fact that most of
the medicines purchased was through local
suppliers?
Research projects at AIIMS
23. SHRI SUDARSHAN AKARAPU:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a large number
of research projects at All India Institute of
Medical Sciences, New Delhi are held up
for want of animals to conduct experiments;
(b) if so, since when these projects are at
a standstill;
(c) whether any talks with those
opposing animal experimentation have been
held to break the impasse; and
(d) if so, the details in this regard?
Interference of Animal Rights Activists
in Bio-Medical Research Work
24. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether over-enthusiasm of Animal
Rights Activists is interfering in Bio-
Medical Research Work;
(b) whether it is a fact that National
Institute of Virology, Pune was closed on
that account;
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons of its closure; and
(d) the action taken to ensure that all
Bio-Medical Research Work to save
mankind is not hampered due to such
frivolous grounds?
Dental X-ray machine in Kasturba
Nagar CGHS Dispensary
25. SHRI RAJNATH SINGH
'SURYA': Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether a dental X-ray machine was
procured for use in Kasturba Nagar/Sewa
Nagar, CGHS dispensary in 1998 at a
substantial cost;
(b) if so, whether  the machine is lying
idle since then for want of necessary
equipment/facilities, etc.;
(c) if so, the persons responsible for this
sorry state of affairs and action contemplated
against them for misuse of public money;
(d) the reasons for not arranging
necessary equipment/facilities etc. before
procurement of the machine; and
(e) by when the X-ray machine will be
operational and action initiated in this regard?
Non-honouring of prescriptions by
CGHS Ayurvedic Dispensaries
26. SHRI ANIL SHARMA:
